## SetFrcAssist

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700135.html*

SetFrcAssist
(Library) 
[Version 1.4 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Sets the force assistance under the compliance control (special compliance control function library) (dedicated command for 6-axis).

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetFrcAssist (<Force assistance along X>, <Force assistance along Y>, <Force assistance along Z>, <Moment assistance about X>, <Moment assistance about Y>, <Moment assistance about Z>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

Sets the force assistance along and the moment assistance about X, Y, and Z axes of a coordinate system specified by SetFrcCoord. The maximum set value is 10% of the maximum force limiting value.

The unit for the force setting is [N]. The unit for the moment setting is [Nm]. Up to one decimal place is valid.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

<pacman.h> is required.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[ResetFrcAssist](cmidc20700136.html), [SetFrcCoord](cmidc20700130.html), [SetCompControl](cmidc20700127.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* Execute this command in a task holding robot control conditions (TAKEARM). If robot control conditions are not held, an error message "21F7 Arm semaphore cannot be fetched." is reported.
* Your robot may move toward the direction to which the force assistance and the moment assistance are applied. If this is the case, reduce the set values.
* All the set values for along and around the X, Y and Z axes will be initialized to 0 after the controller is turned on.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| CALL SetFrcCoord (1) | 'Sets the force limiting coordinate system to the tool  'coordinate |
| CALL SetFrcAssist (-30, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) | |
|  | 'Sets the force assistance to 30 [N] toward -X direction |
| CALL SetFrcLimit (0, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100) | |
|  | 'Sets the force limiting rates |
| CALL SetCompControl | 'Enables the compliance control function. Force limiting  'in X direction is 0% and a force of 30 [N] is applied toward  '-X direction |

## SetCompJLimit

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700137.html*

SetCompJLimit
(Library) 
[Version 1.4 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Sets the current limit under the compliance control (special compliance control function library) (dedicated command for 6-axis).

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetCompJLimit (<J1 current limit>, <J2 current limit>, <J3 current limit>, <J4 current limit>, <J5 current limit>, <J6 current limit>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

Sets the current limit under the compliance control. The rated current of a motor corresponds to 100. When you use SetFrcLimit to set 0 to all the directions, the motor currents are limited to values less than the setting.

Setting ranges from 0 to 100.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

<pacman.h> is required.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[ResetCompJLimit](cmidc20700138.html), [SetCompControl](cmidc20700127.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* Execute this command in a task holding robot control conditions (TAKEARM). If robot control conditions are not held, an error message "21F7 Arm semaphore cannot be fetched." is reported.
* The set values will be initialized and all the current limits will be 0 after the controller is turned on.
* When you use SetCompJLimit to set relatively large values, your robot may present an oscillation resulting in an error. If this is the case, use SetCompRate and SetDumpRate to adjust the compliance.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| CALL SetFrcCoord (1) | 'Sets the force limiting coordinate system to the tool  'coordinate |
| CALL SetCompJLimit (30, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) | |
|  | 'Sets the current limit for J1 to 30% |
| CALL SetFrcLimit (0, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100) | |
|  | 'Sets the force limiting rates |
| CALL SetCompControl | 'Enables the compliance control function. |

## SetCompEralw

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700141.html*

SetCompEralw
(Library) 
[Version 1.4 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Sets the allowable deviation values of the position and the posture of the tool tip under the compliance control (dedicated command for 6-axis).

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetCompEralw (<Allowable deviation along X>, <Allowable deviation Y>, <Allowable deviation Z>, <Allowable deviation X>, <Allowable deviation Y>, <Allowable deviation Z>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

Sets the allowable deviation values of the position and the posture of the tool tip under the compliance control. The unit for the allowable deviation along X, Y, and Z is (mm), and the unit for the allowable deviation about X, Y, and Z is (degree). Up to one decimal place is valid.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

<pacman.h> is required.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[ResetCompEralw](cmidc20700142.html), [SetFrcCoord](cmidc20700130.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* Execute this command in a task holding robot control conditions (TAKEARM). If robot control conditions are not held, an error message "21F7 Arm semaphore cannot be fetched." is reported.
* The initial values of allowable deviation are 100 (mm) along X, Y, and Z and 30 (degree) about X, Y, and Z. The maximum value about X, Y, and Z axes is 175 (degree). If you set larger values than the maximum value, you will receive an error "6003 Valid range was exceeded".
* If the position or the posture deviation of the tool tip exceeds the allowable value, you will receive an error "60f8 Position deviation under compliance control error".
* The coordinate system used for setting the deviation is the one set by SetFrcCoord. When you specify as SetFrcCoord (1), the setting coordinate system for SetCompEralw is the tool coordinate system.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| CALL SetFrcCoord (2) | 'Sets the force limiting coordinate system to the work  'coordinate system |
| CALL SetFrcLimit (100, 0, 100, 100, 100, 100) | |
|  | 'Sets the force limiting rate for the Y direction of the work  'coordinate system to 0% |
| CALL SetCompEralw (10, 150, 10, 5, 5, 5) | |
|  | 'Sets the allowable deviation values along X and Z of the work  'coordinate to 10 (mm), along Y to 150 (mm), and about X, Y,  'and Z to 5 (degree). |

SetDampRate (<Damping rate along X>, <Damping rate along Y>, <Damping rate along Z>, <Damping rate about X>, <Damping rate about Y>, <Damping rate about Z>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

Sets the damping rates along and about X, Y, and Z axes of a coordinate system specified by SetFrcCoord.

## SetVibControl

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700145.html*

SetVibControl
(Library) 
[Version 1.4 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Sets to the residual vibration reduction control mode (dedicated command for 6-axis).

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetVibControl

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

Switches to the residual vibration reduction control mode and reduces the residual vibration when robot stops its motion.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)

* Execute this command in a task holding robot control conditions (TAKEARM). If robot control conditions are not held, an error message "21F7 Arm semaphore cannot be fetched." is reported.
* If you execute SetVibControl while using SetEralw to change the allowable angle deviation, the allowable angle deviation will be initialized. Use SetEralw to set the allowable angle deviation again.
* The path precision will decrease due to motion follow-up delay in the residual vibration reduction control mode. Avoid this mode when the path precision is required.
* When you execute SetVibControl during a path motion, the library is executed after the motion stops. Thus, this will be an execution after stop.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)

## MotionSkip

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700147.html*

MotionSkip
(Library) 
[Version 1.5 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Aborts running motion commands.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

MotionSkip

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

MotionSkip aborts motion commands running in the task in which the MotionSkip executes.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[GetJntData](cmidc11200902.html), [GetSrvData](cmidc11200901.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* Execute this command in a TAKEARMed task that holds an arm semaphore. If not in a TAKEARMed task, the error "Not executable" will result.
* Executing MotionSkip in a robot motion task will abort robot joint motion commands. Executing it in an extended-joint motion task will abort extended-joint motion commands.

  If MotionSkip executes in a motion task holding an arm group involving both robot joints and extended-joints, then both the robot and extended-joint motions will be aborted.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| defjnt lj1 |  |
| defsng lf1 |  |
| move p,P1,next |  |
| lj1=GetSrvState(2) | 'Get errors of each joint rotation angle. |
| lf1=ABS(JOINT(2,lj1)) | 'Select rotation error of J2. |
| if lf1 > 10000 then |  |
| CALL MotionSkip | 'If the rotation error of J2 exceeds 10000  '(in pulses), then abort motion commands. |
| endif |  |

## MotionComp

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700148.html*

MotionComp
(Library) 
[Version 1.5 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Judges whether execution of running motion commands is complete.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

MotionComp(<MotionCommandComplete>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

If MotionComp judges that execution of running motion commands is complete, then it returns "1" in <MotionCommandComplete>.

This command checks motion commands running in the task in which the MotionComp executes. It is not applicable to motion commands in any other tasks.

If a motion command has an encoder value check option, then MotionComp will interpret the moment when the encoder count is converged within the positioning error allowance as completion of the motion command. For other operations, if motion control to the servo loop disappears, then MotionComp will judge that the command is complete.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[GetJntData](cmidc11200902.html), [GetSrvData](cmidc11200901.html), [MotionSkip](cmidc20700147.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* Execute this command in a TAKEARMed task that holds an arm semaphore. If not in a TAKEARMed task, the error "Not executable" will result.
* Executing MotionComp in a robot motion task will judge whether robot motion commands are complete. Executing it in an extended-joint motion task will judge whether extended-joint motion commands are complete.

  If MotionComp executes in a motion task holding an arm group involving both robot joints and extended-joints, then completion of both the robot and extended-joint motions will be judged.
* When the motion is on Halt, MotionComp will interpret it as operation being in progress.
* If you use a local variable for <MotionCommandComplete>, the local variable must be reset to "0" beforehand.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| defint comp=0 | 'Initialize motion command completion status. |
| defjnt lj1 |  |
| defsng lf1 |  |
| move p,P1,next |  |
| DO |  |
| lj1=GetSrvState(2) | 'Get error of each joint rotation. |
| lf1=ABS(JOINT(2,lj1)) | 'Select the rotation error of J2. |
| if lf1 > 10000 then |  |
| CALL MotionSkip | 'If the rotation error of J2 exceeds 10000 (in pulses),  'then abort motion commands and end the loop. |
| EXIT DO |  |
| endif |  |
| CALL MotionComp(comp) |  |
| LOOP UNTIL comp=1 | 'Loop until the end of motion commands. |

## ArchMove

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700149.html*

ArchMove
(Library) 
[(Version 1.9 or later)]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Executes an arch motion.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

ArchMove (<destination (Position variable)>, <Z-axis move>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

This library makes a pick-and-place motion from current position P1 (pick) to destination position P4 (place) via the vicinity of route positions P2 and P3.

The route position P3 is located above destination position P4 by the vertical move distance (L1) specified by <Z-axis move>.

The route position P2 is on the Z axis of source position P1 and has the same Z-axis value as P3.

Arch start position (L2) and end position (L3) should be defined in the SetArchParam library.

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmidc20700149_01.jpg)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

Requires file <pacman.h>

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[SetArchParam](cmidc20700150.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* Execute this library in a TAKEARMed task that holds an arm semaphore.
* An arch motion does not support the position control so that the path of the arm endpoint may vary depending upon the actual robot speed. Be careful with interference with the surrounding facilities when the robot is in arch motion.
* The Z-axis value of the source position and that of the destination position are not identical with each other. Otherwise, this library will not function normally.
* This library is not available to the work coordinates system. Use it in the base coordinates system.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| CALL ArchMove (P10,100) | 'Moves the arm endpoint to destination P10  'with 100 mm Z-axis move. The current arch  'start and end positions will apply. |

  

[Top](#top)

## SetArchParam

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700150.html*

SetArchParam
(Library) 
[(Version 1.9 or later)]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Defines the start position of a horizontal movement (Arch start position) in upward movement of the arm endpoint and the end position in downward movement (Arch end position).

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetArchParam (<Arch start position>, <Arch end position>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

This library configures an arch form.

<Arch start position> is the distance (mm) from the source position in the direction of the Z axis; <Arch end position> is that from the destination position.

The entry range is from 0 to "Maximum reach position (mm) in the Z-axis direction" in increment of 1 mm.

The defaults of <Arch start position> and <Arch end position> are 0 mm when the robot controller is turned on.

Values defined in this library will be effective until the robot controller is turned off.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

Requires file <pacman.h>

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[ArchMove](cmidc20700149.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

Specifying any invalid value will cause no syntax error, but it will result in a run-time error at the execution of the ArchMove.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| CALL SetArchParam (10,20) | 'Set the arch form so that the arm endpoint  'moves upward 10 mm, starts horizontal move  'and ends it 20 mm above the destination. |
| <Program lines hidden> |  |
| Call ArchMove (P10,100) | 'Execute arch motion towards destination P10  'with 100 mm Z-axis vertical move. |

## SetMonitorCond

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700151.html*

SetMonitorCond
(Library) 
[Version 1.5 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Sets the monitoring conditions for single-joint servo data monitor.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetMonitorCond(<JntNumber>,<MonitorData1>,<MonitorData2>,

<SampInterval>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

SetMonitorCond sets the joint number to be monitored, monitor data (up to 2 types allowed per command), and sampling interval in ms as monitoring conditions.

The following five types of data may be monitored, two types at a time, by specifying <MonitorData1> and <MonitorData2>:

| <MonitorData1> and <MonitorData2> | Data to be monitored |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Motor speed control value in rpm |
| 1 | Current motor speed (Actual speed) in rpm |
| 2 | Motor torque control value (excluding torque offset) in ratio (%) to the rated value |
| 3 | Motor rotation angle error (Motor angle control value - Actual motor angle value) in pulses |
| 4 | Motor current absolute value (Maximum value out of three absolute values detected from all 3 phases of the motor.) in ratio (%) to the rated value |

  

<SampInterval> must be set in ms as an integer between 1 and 8.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[ClearSrvMonitor](cmidc20700154.html), [StartSrvMonitor](cmidc20700152.html), [StopSrvMonitor](cmidc20700153.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* If this library executes following the monitor start library StartSrvMonitor, the error "6001: Not executable" will result. Be sure to set the monitoring conditions before starting monitor.
* If any of the joint number, data types, and sampling interval entered is wrong, the error message "The entered value is out of the range." will result. Correct those monitoring conditions you entered.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| CALL SetMonitorCond(7,0,3,4) | 'For getting speed control value and  'motor angle error of J7 every 4 ms. |
| CALL StartSrvMonitor | 'Start monitoring data. |

## StartSrvMonitor

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700152.html*

StartSrvMonitor
(Library) 
[Version 1.5 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Starts monitoring single-joint servo data.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

StartSrvMonitor

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

StartSrvMonitor fetches a maximum of 1250 samples of single-joint servo data until StopSrvMonitor executes.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[ClearSrvMonitor](cmidc20700154.html), [SetMonitorCond](cmidc20700151.html), [StopSrvMonitor](cmidc20700153.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* If the total number of data samples monitored in a monitoring cycle is 1250 or less, all data may be monitored. If it exceeds 1250 samples, the last 1250 data samples before the end of the cycle may be monitored and other data will be discarded.
* If any error occurs and the motor being monitored is turned OFF during monitoring, then a maximum of 850 samples before the OFF and 400 samples after that may be monitored.
* No data may be monitored when the target motor is off. Execute this command with the motor power on.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| CALL SetMonitorCond(7,0,3,4) | 'For getting speed control value and  'motor angle error of J7 every 4 ms. |
| CALL StartSrvMonitor | 'Start monitoring data. |

* If the total number of data samples monitored in a monitoring cycle is 1250 or less, all data may be monitored. If it exceeds 1250, the last 1250 data samples before the end of the cycle may be monitored and other data will be discarded.
* If any error occurs and the motor being monitored is turned OFF during monitoring, then a maximum of 850 samples before the OFF and 400 samples after that may be monitored.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)

## xdWAITSPLINE

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700155.html*

xdWAITSPLINE
(Library) 
[Version 2.3 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Waits for the free curve to pass the designated viapoint.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

xdWAITSPLINE (<Viapoint number>, <Waiting condition>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

Free curve motion in progress waits until passage on the point designated by the <Viapoint number>.

If 0 is designated as the <Waiting condition>, the robot waits until the command value passes the designated viapoint.

If a different value is specified, the robot waits until the encoder value passes the designated viapoint.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[MOVE](cmidc11200207.html), [SETSPLINEPOINT](cmidc11200220.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

When xdWAITSPLINE is called with the free curve not executed, the robot does not wait.

Also, if xdWAITSPLINE is called after passing the viapoint designated by the <Viapoint number>, the robot does not wait.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| PROGRAM PRO1 |  |
| TAKEARM |  |
| CLRSPLINEPOINT 5 | 'Clears all viapoints for the free curve  'with path No. 5. |
| SETSPLINEPOINT 5, P4 | 'Sets P4 as the first viapoint for the free  'curve with trajectory 5. |
| SETSPLINEPOINT 5, P1 | 'Sets P1 as the second viapoint for the free  'curve with trajectory 5. |
| SETSPLINEPOINT 5, J5 | 'Sets J5 as the third viapoint for the free  'curve with trajectory 5. |
| MOVE S, 5, NEXT | 'Executes free curve motion to J5 through P4  'and P1. |
| CALL xdWAITSPLINE(1,1) | 'Waits until the robot passes the first  'viapoint (P4). |
| SET IO[240] | 'Sets port 240 to ON. |
| CALL xdWAITSPLINE(2,1) | 'Waits until the robot passes the  'second viapoint (P1). |
| RESET IO[240] | 'Sets port 240 to OFF. |

## xdSPLClrTakeArm

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700157.html*

xdSPLClrTakeArm
(Library) 
[Version 2.3 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Changes the validity of free curve viapoint clear process execution during TakeArm.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

xdSPLClrTakeArm (<Set value>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

If the <Set value> is 0, the viapoint of the free curve during TakeArm is not cleared.

If the <Set value> is a different value, the viapoints of the free curve during TakeArm are cleared.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

In the initial state after controller power on, free curve viapoints are cleared during TakeArm. To register the free curve notion viapoints other than by the free curve motion program (for registration by the intialization program), set by CALL xdSPLClrTakeArm(0) so as not to clear the viapoints for the free curve during Take Arm.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)

| --- | --- |

| SETSPLINEPOINT 5, P4 | 'Sets P4 as the first viapoint for the free  'curve with trajectory 5. |
| SETSPLINEPOINT 5, P1 | 'Sets P1 as the second viapoint for the free  'curve with trajectory 5. |
| SETSPLINEPOINT 5, J5 | 'Sets J5 as the third viapoint for the free  'curve with trajectory 5. |
| CALL xdSPLClrTakeArm (0) | 'Does not clear the viapoints of the free  'curve during TakeArm. |

## SetHighPathAccuracy

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700158.html*

SetHighPathAccuracy
(Library) 
[Ver. 2.61 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Enable (or disable) the high-accuracy path control that improves the accuracy of the robot motion path in CP motions (linear, arc, and free-curve).

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetHighPathAccuracy

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

* This function improves the accuracy of the robot motion path.
* This function becomes enabled for a motion command immediately following SetHighPathAccuracy and canceled with ResetHighPathAccuracy.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

Requires a <pacman.h> file.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[ResetHighPathAccuracy](cmidc20700159.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* This control should be enabled only for motions requiring high-accuracy path.
* Depending on motions or load conditions, some robot motions involve vibration. If it happens, lower the speed or acceleration or disable this control.
* Turning the controller or motor power OFF disables this control.
* This control does not apply to the extended joints (7th- and 8th-axis).
* This control cannot be enabled when the compliance control is enabled. Trying to do so causes an error.
* This control cannot be enabled when a motion such as a pass motion is in progress.
* The master control parameters (e.g., mass of payload and payload center of gravity) should be accurately specified. Failure to do so may hinder this control.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| PROGRAM PRO1 |  |
| TAKEARM | 'Obtain the control priority of the arm group. |
| MOVE P, @E P1 | 'Move to P1 in the PTP motion. |
| CALL SetHighPathAccuracy | 'Enable the high-accuracy path control. |
| MOVE S, 5 | 'Move the robot arm along path #5  'in free-curve motion under high-accuracy  'path control. |
| CALL ResetHighPathAccuracy | 'Disable the high-accuracy path control. |
| MOVE P, @0 P5 | 'Move from P4 to P5 in the PTP motion. |
| END | 'End the program. |

## SetSingularAvoid

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700160.html*

SetSingularAvoid
(Library) 
[Ver. 2.61 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Enable or disable the singular point avoiding function. (for 6-axis robots)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetSingularAvoid(<ON·OFF>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

If <ON·OFF> is 1, the singular point avoiding function becomes enabled; if it is 0, the function becomes disabled.

Enabling the function suppresses a large 4-axis rotation that is caused when the 5 axis passes through the vicinity of 0 degree in linear, arc or free-curve motion under CP interpolation control.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

Requires a <pacman.h> file.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* This function does not take effect in 4- and 5-axis robots.
* This function does not take effect under PTP interpolation control.
* When this function is enabled, the robot arm may greatly go out of the original path depending on the motion conditions.
* The singular point avoiding function does not work on older engine boards.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| PROGRAM PRO1 |  |
| TakeArm | 'Obtain the control priority. |
| MOVE P, P1 | 'Move to P1 in PTP motion. |
| CALL SetSingularAvoid (1) | 'Enable singular point avoiding function. |
| MOVE L, P2 | 'Move to P2 under linear interpolation  'control. |
| CALL SetSingularAvoid (0) | 'Disable singular point avoiding function. |

| · |  |
| · |  |
| END |  |

Enable the collision detection for the specified joint.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetCollisionJnt(<joint#>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

This library enables the collision detection for the joint specified by <joint#>.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

Requires file <pacman.h>

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[ResetCollisionJnt](cmidc20700162.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* <joint#> should be a robot joint number. If it is a joint other than robot ones, the error message "Excess in effective joint value range" ("Specified joint out of range") appears.
* This library cannot be executed when the compliance control is enabled.
* The collision detection function works with the corresponding controller software versions.

  When using project data older than the controller versions below, see "collision detection functions" in the PROGRAMMER'S MANUAL I.

+ VS-G series: Version 2.61 or later
+ VS-\*\*\* series: Version 3.20 or later
+ VM-G, VP-G series: Version 2.70 or later
+ HM-G, HS-G series: Version 2.80 or later

* The collision detection function does not work on an old engine board.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| TAKEARM | 'Get robot control priority |
| CALL SetCollisionJnt(2) | 'Enable collision detection for joint 2 |
| MOVE P, P1, P2 | 'With collision detection enabled, move  'from point P1 to P2 in PTP motion |
| CALL ResetCollisionJnt(2) | 'Disable collision detection for joint 2 |
| MOVE P, P2, P3 | 'With collision detection disabled, move  'from point P2 to P3 in PTP motion |

## GetCollisionForce

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700163.html*

GetCollisionForce
[Ver. 2.61 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Get the maximum external force.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

GetCollisionForce(<joint variable>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

This library assigns the maximum external force detected to a joint variable specified by <joint variable>.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[ClearCollisionForce](cmidc20700164.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* The maximum external force can be calculated only for joints whose collision detection is enabled when the corresponding motors are ON, in each of Manual and Auto modes.
* In Auto mode, this library assigns the maximum external force calculated in Auto mode; in Manual or Teach check mode, it assigns the one calculated in Manual mode.
* The collision detection function works with the corresponding controller software versions.

  When using project data older than the controller versions below, see "collision detection functions" in the PROGRAMMER'S MANUAL I.

+ VS-G series: Version 2.61 or later
+ VS-\*\*\* series: Version 3.20 or later
+ VM-G, VP-G series: Version 2.70 or later
+ HM-G, HS-G series: Version 2.80 or later

* The collision detection function does not work on an old engine board.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| TAKEARM | 'Get robot control priority |
| CALL ClearCollisionForce | 'Initialize maximum external force stored |
| CALL SetCollisionJnt(2) | 'Enable collision detection for joint 2 |
| MOVE P, P1, P2 | 'Move from point P1 to P2 in PTP motion |
| CALL GetCollisionForce(J1) | 'Assign maximum external force calculated  'during move from P1 to P2 to variable J1 |
| CALL ClearCollisionForce | 'Initialize maximum external force stored |
| MOVE P, P2, P3 | 'Move from point P2 to P3 in PTP motion |
| CALL GetCollisionForce(J2) | 'Assign maximum external force calculated  'during move from P2 to P3 to variable J2 |

## SetCollisionLevel

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700165.html*

SetCollisionLevel
[Ver. 2.61 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Specify the collision detection sensitivity level for the specified joint.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetCollisionLevel(<joint#, level>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

This library defines the collision detection sensitivity level specified by <level> for the joint specified by <joint#>. The typical detection sensitivity level is 100. Decreasing the level increases the collision detection sensitivity; increasing it decreases the sensitivity.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

Requires file <pacman.h>

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[SetCollisionJnt](cmidc20700161.html), [ResetCollisionJnt](cmidc20700162.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* <joint#> should be a robot joint number. If it is a joint other than robot ones, the error message "Excess in effective joint value range" ("Specified joint out of range") appears.
* This library cannot be executed when the compliance control is enabled.
* If the robot detects a false collision, increase the detection sensitivity level to decrease the detection sensitivity.
* The collision detection function works with the corresponding controller software versions.

  When using project data older than the controller versions below, see "collision detection functions" in the PROGRAMMER'S MANUAL I.

+ VS-G series: Version 2.61 or later
+ VS-\*\*\* series: Version 3.20 or later
+ VM-G, VP-G series: Version 2.70 or later
+ HM-G, HS-G series: Version 2.80 or later

* The collision detection function does not work on an old engine board.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| TAKEARM | 'Get robot control priority |
| CALL SetCollisionJnt(3) | 'Enable collision detection for joint 3 |
| CALL SetCollisionLevel(3,80) | 'Set collision detection sensitivity  'level for joint 3 to 80 |
| MOVE P, P1, P2 | 'With higher detection sensitivity for  'joint 3, move from point P1 to P2 in PTP motion |
| CALL SetCollisionLevel(3,120) | 'Set collision detection sensitivity  'level for joint 3 to 120 |
| MOVE P, P2, P3 | 'With lower detection sensitivity for  'joint 3, move from point P2 to P3 in PTP motion |

## SetExtForceDetect

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700166.html*

SetExtForceDetect
[Ver. 2.61 or later]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Enable/disable detection of external force.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

SetExtForceDetect(<value>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

This library enables or disables detection of external force if <value> is "1" (default) or "0," respectively.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

Requires file <pacman.h>

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[SetCollisionJnt](cmidc20700161.html), [GetCollisionForce](cmidc20700163.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* <value> should be "0" or "1." Any other value results in an error.
* The default of <value> is "1" (Enable). Even if <value> is set to "0" (Disable), it will revert to "1" by switching between Manual and Auto modes or by restarting the robot controller.
* Unlike SetCollisionJoint or ResetCollisionJoint, this library does not enable or disable collision detection. Disabling detection of external force with this library does not update maximum external forces stored even if the robot detects greater external force than the one stored. Use this library when checking the maximum external force in a particular zone.
* The collision detection function works with the corresponding controller software versions.

  When using project data older than the controller versions below, see "collision detection functions" in the PROGRAMMER'S MANUAL I.

+ VS-G series: Version 2.61 or later
+ VS-\*\*\* series: Version 3.20 or later
+ VM-G, VP-G series: Version 2.70 or later
+ HM-G, HS-G series: Version 2.80 or later

* The collision detection function does not work on an old engine board.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| TAKEARM | 'Get robot control priority |
| CALL SetExtForceDetect(0) | 'Disable detection of external forces |
| CALL ClearCollisionForce | 'Initialize the maximum external force |
| CALL SetCollisionJnt(3) | 'Enable collision detection for joint 3 |
| MOVE P, P1, P2 | 'Move from point P1 to P2 in PTP motion |
| CALL SetExtForceDetect(1) | 'Enable detection of external forces |
| MOVE P, P2, P3 | 'Move from point P2 to P3 in PTP motion |
| CALL GetCollisionForce(J2) | 'Assign maximum external force calculated  'during move from P2 to P3 to variable J2 |

## ArchMoveV

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20700167.html*

ArchMoveV
(Library) 
[(Version 3.2 or later)]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Executes an arch motion.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

ArchMoveV (<destination (Position variable)>, <Approach length>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

This library makes a pick-and-place motion from current position P1 (pick) to destination position P4 (place) via the vicinity of route positions P2 and P3.

The route position P3 is located above destination position P4 by the vertical move distance (L1) specified by <Approach length>

The route position P2 is the position raised by the approach length (L1) from the current position.

Arch start position (L2) and end position (L3) should be defined in the SetArchParam library.

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmidc20700149_01.jpg)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-macro.jpg)
  

Requires file <pacman.h>

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-ref.jpg)
  

[SetArchParam](cmidc20700150.html)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-caution.jpg)
  

* Execute this library in a TAKEARMed task that holds an arm semaphore.
* An arch motion does not support the position control so that the path of the arm endpoint may vary depending upon the actual robot speed. Be careful with interference with the surrounding facilities when the robot is in arch motion.
* This library is not available to the work coordinates system. Use it in the base coordinates system.
* This operation may not be possible due to speed error or acceleration error depending on operation conditions. In that case, review the operation conditions and make changes such as lowering the speed.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| CALL ArchMoveV (P10,100) | 'Moves the arm endpoint to destination P10 with approach  'length 100 mm. |

## viTran6

*Source file: en/rc7data/cmidc20900101.html*

viTran6
(Library) 
[for the Vision board]

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-func.jpg)
  

Transforms the vision coordinates to robot coordinates (for 6 axes).

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-format.jpg)
  

viTran6 (<Calibration number>, <Vision coordinate X>, <Vision coordinate Y>, <Robot coordinate (P type)>)

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-exp.jpg)
  

This statement transforms the vision coordinates (X, Y) to the robot absolute coordinates (X, Y, Z).

For execution of this library, it is required to execute vision calibration and transmit the vision calibration data with the controller.

Designate a number which executes vision calibration as a calibration number.

With this coordinate transformation, only the absolute coordinates (X, Y, Z) can be obtained. Figure data must be set separately in order to execute the MOVE instruction.

  

![](DensoRC8_manual_combined_images/cmd-sample.jpg)
  

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
|  | 'Stores the vision coordinate X to F1. |
|  | 'Stores the vision coordinate Y to F2. |
| TAKEARM |  |
| CHANGETOOL 1 | 'Sets the fool to which vision calibration was performed. |
| MOVE P,P10 | 'Moves to the stand-by position. |
| P11 = P10 | 'Copies the figure at the stand-by position. |
| CALL viTran6(0, F1, F2, P11) | |
|  | 'Transforms the vision coordinates to the robot coordinates  '("0" of vision calibration is used). |
| APPROACH P, P11, 100 |  |
| MOVE L, P11 | 'Moves to the position measured with vision. |
| DEPART L,100 |  |
| CHANGETOOL 0 |  |
